feature: Reference-inspired miniature food art and freely overlapping fridge arrangements

art.source: Built-in image generation using the user-provided image as style reference
art.prompt_summary: Warm ivory and sage, tactile 3D miniature groceries and eight plated Korean meals; matching soft daylight, transparent background, separate atlas sprites without brand text.
art.presentation: One locally hosted atlas, per-sprite clipped SVG viewports, shared across fridge, inventory, recipe ingredients, shopping list and the selected dish.

verified: Eight synthetic inventory lots displayed; duplicate egg names retained their separate 2개 and 7개 quantities
Actual mouse dragging between compartments and into a specific shelf position
Cheese and carrot placed at overlapping coordinates; layer-back changed their order without changing coordinates
Reload preserved both overlap coordinates and relative stacking order
390px and 320px home views preserved the normalized placement without horizontal overflow
320px, 390px and 430px recipe layouts displayed the miniature art without page/card horizontal overflow
Transparent miniature silhouettes visually inspected in the browser
browser.test_data: Synthetic local preview only; no production stock was added.

independent_regressions: A delayed move is rejected when its source door was closed before the storage event arrived
Queued materialization uses the latest per-shelf item order
Changing one layer preserves the relative order and saved coordinates of other items

preservation.migration: Version 1 is read in memory without writing; the first actual preference change writes version 2.

limits: Mobile screen widths were checked in desktop Chrome iframes, not on physical phones.
Touch pointer behavior and cancellation were tested through DOM events; real browser interaction used mouse dragging.
Door state, positions and stacking order are local browser preferences, separate from the existing inventory sync payload.
